comment: A DOI becomes https://doi.org/<doi>, a Handle https://hdl.handle.net/<handle>; a URL is kept. Any other identifier becomes a urn: of its type and value.
A PropertyValue: propertyID is the identifiers.org registry entry for the identifierType (doi, hdl), else the identifierType; schema:url resolves it.
The identifier's resolver URL, which is the landing page. With none, schema:url is the OGC nil URI.
Each as a PropertyValue whose propertyID is its alternateIdentifierType; schema:url when the type resolves (DOI, Handle, URL, ARK, PMID).
The first title with no titleType: DataCite's main title.
Used when every title has a titleType.
AlternativeTitle, Subtitle, TranslatedTitle and Other titles.

In order, as a JSON-LD @list. nameType picks Person or Organization; without it, a givenName, familyName or ORCID, or a comma in the name, makes a Person. nameIdentifiers (ORCID, ROR, ISNI, GND) become schema:identifier; the first affiliation becomes schema:affiliation, with its ROR.
An Organization; kernel 4.5's publisherIdentifier becomes its identifier.
Also listed as a contributor with roleName HostingInstitution (next rows).
Kernel 3 names funders as contributors; kernel 4 has fundingReference. A MonetaryGrant with the contributor as funder.
A schema:Role whose roleName is the contributorType (a DefinedTerm in DataCite's contributorType vocabulary) and whose schema:contributor is the agent, built as for a creator.
A MonetaryGrant: funderName and funderIdentifier (Crossref Funder ID, ROR, ISNI, GRID) are the funder; awardNumber, with awardURI as its url, the identifier; awardTitle the name.
The latest Updated date.
With no Updated date, the Issued date is the last modification.
The year padded to YYYY-01-01, as the ISO converter does: CDIF needs at least a year and month. With no date at all, dateModified is the sentinel 1900-01-01.
The year alone, when there is no Issued date.
A date or an RKMS-ISO8601 range (start/end), as written. Coverage is kernel 4.5's date type for the period the data covers.

A DefinedTerm when the subject has a subjectScheme, schemeURI, valueURI or classificationCode: inDefinedTermSet is the schemeURI, else the subjectScheme; valueURI is its @id and url; classificationCode its termCode. Otherwise a plain string.
As written (ISO 639 or BCP 47).
resourceTypeGeneral as a DefinedTerm in DataCite's resourceTypeGeneral vocabulary, and the free-text resourceType as a string. @type stays schema:Dataset, which CDIF requires.
A CreativeWork whose url is the rightsURI and whose name is the text, else the rightsIdentifier; a statement with no URI is kept as a string.

The OpenAIRE COAR access right (info:eu-repo/semantics/openAccess, embargoedAccess, restrictedAccess, closedAccess) is an access condition, not a licence. With neither a licence nor an access condition, schema:license is the OGC nil URI.
The Abstract(s), then each other description labelled with its descriptionType (Methods, TechnicalInfo, SeriesInformation, TableOfContents, Other). With none, the description is the name.
A Place: geoLocationPlace is its name; the box (kernel 3 text 'S W N E', or kernel 4 bound elements) a GeoShape box, else the polygon a GeoShape polygon, else the point GeoCoordinates.

A LinkRole whose linkRelationship is the relationType (a DefinedTerm in DataCite's relationType vocabulary) and whose target is an EntryPoint at the identifier's resolver URL; an identifier with no resolver is the target's name.
Also a relatedLink (row above).
Each distinct format. DataCite gives no download URL to hang a distribution on, so the formats describe the dataset.
Free text ('15 pages', '384928'), often one per file with no link to the file; not converted.
